personas.name: Worker
personas.summary: A worker can access wage protections, safe working conditions, and legal remedies for unpaid wages or unfair dismissal.

rights.title: Minimum Wages
rights.detail: Workers are entitled to minimum wages and timely payment for all hours worked.
rights.remedy: File a wage claim with the labour office and demand payment with interest if due.

rights.title: Safe Workplace
rights.detail: Employers must provide safe conditions, protective equipment, and compliant working hours.
rights.remedy: Report hazards to the labour inspector and seek compensation for injuries.

personas.grievanceTemplate: I am a worker employed at [company name]. I have not received [wages/benefits] as required under labour laws. I request inspection, payment of dues, and protection from retaliation.

personas.name: Senior
personas.summary: A senior citizen can seek pensions, age-based protections, and safeguarding against abuse or neglect.

rights.title: Pension & Support
rights.detail: Senior citizens may be eligible for pension, old age allowance, and financial support schemes.
rights.remedy: Apply through the district social welfare office and follow up with documentation.

rights.title: Protection from Abuse
rights.detail: Elders are protected against neglect, financial exploitation, and abuse in care settings.
rights.remedy: Report abuse to the police, district authorities, or senior welfare board.

personas.grievanceTemplate: I am a senior citizen facing [neglect/exploitation/denial of pension]. I request urgent support, documentation review, and legal protection under senior welfare laws.

personas.name: Tribal
personas.summary: A tribal citizen can assert forest rights, community land rights, and protection against displacement or exploitation.

rights.title: Forest Rights
rights.detail: Tribal communities may have rights to cultivate, collect forest produce, and protect customary land.
rights.remedy: Submit a claim with the local revenue and forest authorities and seek review of recognition.

rights.title: Non-displacement
rights.detail: Communities must be consulted before development projects or relocation affecting their land and livelihood.
rights.remedy: Request a public hearing, legal review, and compensation or rehabilitation if required.

personas.grievanceTemplate: I belong to a tribal community and my rights over [land/forest resources] are being denied. I request recognition of my rights, consultation, and protection from unlawful displacement.

personas.name: Women
personas.summary: A woman can access protections against workplace discrimination, domestic violence, and unequal treatment.

rights.title: Equal Pay & Safety
rights.detail: Women are protected from workplace discrimination, unequal pay, and unsafe conditions.
rights.remedy: File a complaint with the labour department, internal complaint committee, or local authority.

rights.title: Protection Against Violence
rights.detail: Women can seek protection from domestic violence, harassment, and coercive conduct.
rights.remedy: Approach the police, women’s helpline, or legal aid cell for urgent relief and support.

personas.grievanceTemplate: I am a woman facing [harassment/discrimination/violence] in my workplace or home. I seek protection, fair treatment, and legal remedies available under women’s rights laws.
